README: principles, writing, colour, type, spacing Screen anatomy: the four screen kinds tokens.json

Navigation

BackBar

Guidelines

A pushed page's top bar: the Back link on the left, the page title fading in at the centre once you scroll.

PageHeading

Guidelines

The large page title that starts every screen, with at most one control beside it.

StickyBar

Guidelines

The bar that takes over a tab root's title once the page heading scrolls away.

TabBar

Guidelines

The bottom menu: four fixed tabs that switch between the tab roots.

Content

Hero

Guidelines

A screen's one headline amount: a label, the figure, and how it has moved.

MetricGrid

Guidelines

Two columns of labelled figures, for the numbers behind a hero.

Section

Guidelines

A titled block of a page, separated from the one above by a 6px band.

Lists

AccountRow

Guidelines

A row for an account, a cash balance or an account's holding: a glyph or symbol, a name, and a value.

DetailRows

Guidelines

Label and value pairs that describe one record, under its figure.

HoldingRow

Guidelines

One position in the Portfolio ledger: its share of the whole as a ring, the symbol and shares, and its value and return.

LedgerRow

Guidelines

One transaction in the history: a kind icon, what happened, and what it did to the account's cash.

Actions

BottomActions

Guidelines

A pushed page's main pair of actions, pinned where the tab bar was.

Button

Guidelines

The full-width action at the end of a form, sheet or empty state, plus the smaller text and icon actions.

ChartControls

Guidelines

The range picker above a price chart and the indicator toggles under it.

FilterChips

Guidelines

A row of filters, each showing its current value and opening an OptionList sheet.

Sheets

OptionGrid

Guidelines

A sheet's grid of short options that apply as soon as one is tapped.

OptionList

Guidelines

A sheet's list of options to pick one from, each with a description and how many records it matches. Tapping an option applies it and closes the sheet.

Sheet

Guidelines

A bottom sheet that slides up over the screen for a quick choice, a short form, or one record's details.

Forms

Field

Guidelines

A labelled text, number or select field on a recessed fill, with its error line.

TaskScreen

Guidelines

A full-screen form for creating something: one question, its fields, and one action pinned at the bottom.

Feedback

EmptyState

Guidelines

What a list shows when it has nothing to show: a line icon, a headline, two short lines, and the way forward.
